title: add-benchmark-lab-profiling-baselines-and-reporting-pipeline-v108
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: expand the Benchmark Lab to include the next set of profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and an updated reporting pipeline so we can capture stable baselines for v108. This enables consistent longitudinal performance tracking across model variants and infra changes.

What this PR does: adds profiling baselines for cold-start and steady-state runs, implements representative workload runners for chat/generation/embeddings (config-driven), and wires a reporting pipeline that aggregates profiles, per-run metrics, and artifacts to the telemetry store. Includes lightweight docs and a smoke test harness.

Checklist:
- [x] Add profiling baselines (cold-start + steady-state)
- [x] Add representative workload runners with config-driven scenarios
- [x] Add reporting pipeline jobs + ingestion scripts
- [x] Add unit + integration smoke tests for runners
- [x] Update benchmark-lab docs and runbook

Notes: prioritized incremental changes to minimize runtime risk. Reporting pipeline is opt-in via a new config flag; default behavior mirrors existing v107 outputs to avoid downstream breakage. Linear links: ENG-1287 (profiling baselines), ENG-2012 (reporting pipeline). Related incident: SUP-4021 surfaced a regression in cold-start times for 8-bit quantized variants, this PR adds targeted baselines to monitor that class of regression.

review_conversation: Miguel Torres: Overall looks good — appreciate the small incremental commits. Two requests: (1) can we make the ingest idempotent? (2) add a short timeout to the runners to avoid indefinite hangs.
Aisha Patel: Thanks — addressed both. ingest is now idempotent using run_id dedupe and runners have a 30m default timeout; pushed as commit 4.
Ravi Singh: CI flaked on the smoke test matrix on first run (test timeout). Re-ran and everything passed. Left a nit for logging level on the parse_profile util.
Aisha Patel: lowered logging to INFO in parse_profile and added a unit test that covers the edge case Ravi found.
Elena Gomez: Docs look clear. One suggestion: add a short 'how to add a new scenario' subsection. I added a small doc patch in commit 5.

Miguel Torres: Approving after smoke test green.
Reviewers approved: Miguel Torres (approved), Ravi Singh (approved), Elena Gomez (approved)

merge_outcome: Merged via squash and merge. Release note: adds v108 profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and a new reporting ingestion pipeline (opt-in). Backwards-compatible; default output matches v107.
release_notes:
- Add v108 profiling baselines (cold-start + steady-state)
- Add representative workload runners for chat/generation/embeddings
- Add reporting pipeline and ingestion scripts (opt-in)

notes_for_ops: Reporting pipeline is behind 'BENCH_REPORTING_V108=true' flag in benchmark-lab/.env. Ingestion writes to telemetry bucket 'redwood-bench-profile-v108' by default; ensure retention policy is set to 180 days. If Jenkins/airflow workers are upgraded, re-run the baseline jobs to validate kernels remain stable.
